46368.note: City-owned riverside fish camp on Heckscher Drive serving wild-caught fish and shrimp bought straight off local boats.
46368.fn: A fish camp has stood on this Heckscher Drive site since the 1950s, but the old building was removed after the city bought the land in 2002; the current restaurant opened in a new building on July 1, 2017 (Visit Jacksonville).
